title: Builder Extended Rate Lock and the Purchase Agreement It Finances
content:
A Builder Extended Rate Lock exists only to finance a Calloway purchase agreement whose financing type is Calloway Home Mortgage, and it follows that agreement.

## Clauses

1. **Request.** A lock is requested only for a purchase agreement whose financing type is Calloway Home Mortgage and whose status is ratified, under construction or closing scheduled. Both facts are read from the system record of the purchase agreement named on the lock request, before the lock is requested.
2. **Agreement cancelled or terminated.** When the purchase agreement is cancelled or terminated, the lock is cancelled on the same date.
3. **Financing moved away.** When the buyer changes the agreement's financing away from Calloway Home Mortgage, the buyer withdraws the lock.
4. **Homesite transfer.** Where the lock term does not let a lock survive a homesite transfer on the purchase agreement, a homesite transfer on the agreement requires the buyer to withdraw the lock and request a new one.

## Request test

| Financing type on the agreement | Agreement status | Lock may be requested under clause 1 |
|---|---|---|
| Calloway Home Mortgage | ratified, under construction or closing scheduled | Yes |
| Calloway Home Mortgage | any other status | No |
| any other financing | any status | No |

## Events on the agreement and their effect on the lock

| Event on the purchase agreement | Effect on the Builder Extended Rate Lock |
|---|---|
| Agreement cancelled or terminated | Lock cancelled, dated the day the agreement ended |
| Financing changed away from Calloway Home Mortgage | The buyer withdraws the lock |
| Homesite transfer, on a term whose lock does not survive it | The buyer withdraws the lock and requests a new one |

A withdrawal is the buyer's own act; a cancellation follows the agreement.
